exposure: Planned home birth with intrapartum transfer to hospital
Planned midwife-led unit birth with intrapartum transfer to hospital
cohort: The study cohort comprised 286,056 singleton term pregnancies delivered in Austria between 2017 and 2021.
finding: Intrapartum transfers from planned home or midwife-led unit births to hospital were associated with higher intervention rates and significantly poorer neonatal outcomes (Apgar score, pH value, neonatal transfer rate) compared to planned hospital births.
mod_finding: Births requiring transfer from planned home or midwife-led units to hospital were associated with higher rates of vacuum delivery and emergency c-sections compared to planned hospital births.
cross-section timing: Data collected from 1 January 2017 to 31 December 2021
